time/local_datetime#

A local calendar date and wall-clock time without an offset or time zone.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let start = LocalDateTime(
    date: Date(year: 2026, month: 8, day: 11),
    time: TimeOfDay(hour: 23, minute: 30, second: 0, nanosecond: 0),
);
let finish = start.plus(Duration(seconds: (2 * 3600).rat())); // 2026-08-12T01:30:00

Description#

A local calendar date and wall-clock time without an offset or time zone.

Arithmetic treats every civil day as exactly 86,400 seconds. This object does not model daylight-saving transitions, offsets, leap seconds or an instant on a global timeline. Those interpretations require an explicit time-zone object. Results outside Date years 1..9999 throw InvalidDate.
